guitar.modelsText: ESP Explorer-style / ESP KH models / Gibson Explorer
guitar.evidence: James Hetfield's ESP Explorer-style "Iron Cross" guitars and Kirk Hammett's ESP KH signature models (and earlier Jackson/Gibson Flying V/Explorer use) are extensively documented.

tone.target: dark, tight Mesa-style rhythm with clean intro arpeggios and lead bite
tone.profile: dark, tight Mesa-style rhythm with clean intro arpeggios and lead bite
tone.summary: A tight, scooped Mesa-style tone achieved using the Recti amp model and Distortion pedal, paired with a 4x12 cabinet. Chorus is avoided to maintain clarity in arpeggios.
corrections: replace fuzz with tight high-gain distortion
drop wah as a signature cue
keep clean parts dry and clear

blocks.purpose: Tighten the high-gain rhythm and eliminate hum.
Provide initial punch and tighten the low end for chugging rhythm.
blocks.gap: A dedicated overdrive/boost pedal is used to simulate the attack needed before high gain.

blocks.purpose: Achieve the scooped, tight high-gain rhythm tone (Mesa/Boogie style).
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is used to simulate modern, aggressive metal distortion.

alternatives.model: RAT-style (if a more mid-focused aggression is desired)

blocks.purpose: Simulate the high-gain power section required for tight rhythm and lead bite.

alternatives.model: UK 800 (if a slightly more vintage, but still aggressive tone is acceptable)

blocks.purpose: Provide the necessary punch and clarity for modern metal tones.
blocks.gap: The Mess 4x12 is chosen for its versatility in handling aggressive, scooped sounds.

alternatives.model: UK Vintage 4x12 (if a slightly more British feel is desired)

blocks.purpose: Scoop the mids and tighten the overall frequency response for a modern metal sound.
Bypass the wah pedal as per instructions to maintain clarity.
Avoid chorus wobble as requested; module is bypassed.
Provide subtle echo for lead parts without muddying the rhythm.
blocks.gap: The delay is kept minimal to avoid 'big delay' effect on the main riff.

alternatives.model: Tape (for a warmer, less defined repeat)

blocks.purpose: Provide the required 'studio-tight reverb' for ambience without sounding wet.
blocks.gap: The Room setting provides a natural, controlled decay suitable for studio tightness.

alternatives.model: Plate (for a more defined, metallic shimmer)

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better cabinet realism and punch in modern metal tones.

proposals.reason: Improve the perceived depth and tightness of the 4x12 cab.
